# Brigmedic
1. Your direct superior is the Head of Security.
2. Standard [color=#00a933]Code Green[/color] equipment is:
in
3. Brigmedics are not to provide medical care to individuals that do not fall under their line of care, unless they are in immediate danger.
4. Brigmedics are to provide medical assistance, not act as a Security Officer, unless the current situation on the station demands all hands on deck.
5. Brigmedics are expected to provide medical treatment to any and all prisoners within their care, using the patches, pills, and injectable medications provided to you by the Chemistry team.
